task.name: Re-run the S-1 end to end under sec_filing and score it
task.notes: 2026-11-01, entity_graph_anthropic_s1_v2 (old DB untouched). Extract: infeasible windows 118 -> 0, 17 boilerplate windows skipped, mentions 30,011 -> 33,836, proposals 1,421 -> 2,587. Build (pratt-d3): 776 promoted, 1,787 rejected, 24 pending (gate timeouts that a second build did not clear). Curated with anthropic-s1/curation.json (registrant winner renamed to Anthropic, PBC) plus curate --defaults. eval --from-db: recall 40/60 vs 39/60 before, trap leaks 1/7 vs 7/7 (exhibit-index ACQUIRED, CNAS FOUNDED, LTBT SUBSIDIARY_OF, Razavi MEMBER_OF Class T all gone). Gained: Reddit and Concord SUED Anthropic, Anthropic SUED Department of War, PARTNERED_WITH Google, Hastings MEMBER_OF Anthropic. Lost: Amazon/Google/Microsoft INVESTED_IN (the new entity descriptions no longer tag "our company" in that sentence) and Razavi MEMBER_OF compensation committee (gate rejected). Supplier, underwriter, auditor and counsel facts still 0/9: candidates point at generic nouns, not the registrant. Remaining leak Claude WORKS_FOR Anthropic, and the registrant split into Anthropic (typed PRODUCT from its first mention, though 105 of 114 mentions are ORG) and Anthropic, PBC: both are P9.5. eval now ignores a trailing period in names (Reddit, Inc vs Reddit, Inc.); the old DB still scores 39/60 with it.

task.name: Held-out test: CoreWeave S-1 under sec_filing, profile unchanged
task.notes: 2026-11-01. Gold data/gold/coreweave_s1.jsonl (54 facts, 6 traps) written blind and committed before the run (b541104). DB entity_graph_coreweave_s1: 1,789 windows (9 skipped), 22,560 mentions, 90 defined terms, 1,671 proposals (SUPPLIES 1, SUED 72 with no litigation in the filing), 403 facts built, 98 rejected by the entity-type check. Raw: recall 21/54, 0/6 traps. With the same registrant merges the Anthropic curation used (we/us/company/our/registrant): 23/54 (43%) vs Anthropic 40/60 (67%). People to organization 20/36 (56%) vs 34/38 (89%); company to company 3/18 (17%) vs 6/22 (27%). Does not generalize: CoreWeave bios say "our Chief Financial Officer", and GLiNER tags only 543 of about 6,500 our/we/us occurrences, so 7 officer WORKS_FOR, 3 founder and all investor/supplier/customer/underwriter/counsel facts were never proposed. The registrant definition ("the terms CoreWeave, the Company, we, us, and our refer to") is not a D24 pattern. Traps 0/6 is weak evidence: none was even proposed. Next: treat first-person registrant references as a registrant mention before relation extraction.

decision.title: Relational edge tables + CTEs now, Apache AGE later if needed
GLiNER2 primary extractor; spaCy fallback; LLM only for escalation
Use Jev (SystemOne) for calibrated typed decisions in the extraction pipeline
Reified facts with provenance; relationships are an aggregate view
NetworkX loads only from graph views; pyvis for interactive output
Long documents: overlapping sentence windows with rebased offsets
Jev is not the extractor; keep a local span model for candidates
GLiNER2 backend uses AutoExtractor + gliner2.5-base-v1; CUDA torch from the PyTorch index
Jev integration: alignment routing, batched Noul validation, OpenRouter inference
Sentence boundaries at paragraph breaks, not single newlines
LLM escalation is an opt-in wrapper over the cheap extractor
Pratt router is the default LLM and Jev provider
Relation candidates come from JointIE, not independent relations()
Modality gate: Jev Choice beside the Noul; Decide when there is no key
Gold facts before any cutoff change; 0.5 stays frozen
OCR text is preprocessed at ingest; the document is its own de-hyphenation dictionary
Relation prompts are a selectable profile; the local Clef model is calibrated opt-in
Non-node types are dropped, the graph view is connected-only, surfaces are normalized
Curation is two reversible primitives: merge (repoints edges) and hide
The Pratt router's default Jev model is pratt-d3
Symmetric relations are decoded directed and canonicalized afterwards
A proposal Jev did not answer stays pending
The graph views never expose a self-loop
Defined terms resolve to their long form, scoped to their document
Facts carry validity dates read from their evidence
One pipeline, a document profile per kind of document
